action: Request changes on PR #312. Fix N+1 query in UserService.list() and add unit tests for PaymentProcessor.calculate_refund().
rationale: N+1 query in UserService will generate O(n) database calls on list pages. PaymentProcessor.calculate_refund() has zero test coverage — critical financial logic.

findings.description: N+1 query: iterating over users and calling user.get_orders() in a loop generates 1+N database queries
findings.suggestion: Use select_related('orders') or prefetch_related('orders') to batch the query

findings.description: calculate_refund() has no unit tests. Financial calculations require coverage for edge cases.
findings.suggestion: Add tests for: zero amount, negative amount, amount exceeding original payment, currency mismatch
Rename to reflect the actual operation, e.g. 'format_currency_display()'

key_findings: N+1 query in UserService.list() — O(n) database calls on list pages
